body:
No CI existed anywhere in MIXFORGE. Added .github/workflows/cookie-exporter-ci.yml scoped to tools/cookie-exporter/ -- hermetic, no npm install needed since the extension has no dependencies. Validates manifest.json is real Manifest V3 with every referenced file present, node --check's every JS/MJS file, runs cookies_test.mjs's real Netscape-format assertions, then zips the unpacked extension into a distributable artifact and uploads it. All steps verified locally first, then confirmed live on GitHub: run 36368798087 against commit a859ade -- completed/success. Commit MIXFORGE@a859ade.

⚓ ☃
title: Cookie-exporter extension now has real CI: manifest validation, syntax check, tests, and packaging
